dict.string: M3gaSignalBars is a cosmetic cellular indicator tweak for classic iOS 6. When switched on, it makes the native status-bar signal indicator display five full bars, giving the appearance of a very strong signal.

The tweak changes the bar count used by the native iOS 6 signal-strength view. It keeps the original iOS artwork and status-bar style rather than drawing a separate fake icon over the screen. Switching it off restores the real bar count received from iOS.

Five displayed bars do not mean the phone has better reception. M3gaSignalBars cannot create cellular coverage, unlock a carrier, activate a SIM, or make calls, SMS, or mobile data work. The modem's actual signal is not modified.
Designed for jailbroken iPhone 4S and other ARMv7 devices running iOS 6.0–6.1.3. This is a test release and should be evaluated on the device before wider distribution.
